name: proteside/module-checkout
description: Proteside checkout protection for Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce: helps you meet PCI DSS 4.0 requirements 6.4.3 and 11.6.1 by loading the Proteside client-side protection on your payment pages.

suggest.magento/module-csp: Whitelists the inline bootstrapper hash and the Proteside hosts in the Content-Security-Policy headers (bundled with Magento 2.3.5+).
suggest.magento/module-multishipping: Protection on the multi-address checkout pages.
